text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, this is the one who will be my 
little sister for the day—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It's Curren♪ I'm counting on you for the 
"Call Me Big Sis for Today! Project"!
choice_data_list:
"Call Me Big Sister Just for Today! 
Plan"!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, after all, I've always had the 
wonderful Ryan-oneesama by my side, 
haven't I?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"That is why I wish to become one as well. 
A 'wonderful older sister' just like 
that!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me! Curren is gonna be super 
spoiled, okay?♪

It didn't seem likely to interfere with 
training... and above all, she was 
brimming with motivation, so I decided to 
watch over her, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Are you chewing your food properly~? 
Ryan-onesama always says that taking in 
energy efficiently is very important~."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'm chewing properly♪ Thank you, 
Bright-oneechan!
choice_data_list: (Looks like this will turn out well.)
(Looks like this will turn out well.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
If you get some of your boxed lunch on 
your mouth, I will wipe it off for you. 
Like this—
(Snap!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my~? I knocked over my cup~. Lady 
Curren, did it spill on you~?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! More importantly... Hehe, 
Bright-oneechan, you're all wet. Let me 
dry you off♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Time to fix up my hair after that 
workout~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
When we were little, after running a whole 
bunch, all of us would have Lady Ardan 
brush our hair♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yep♪ Bright-oneechan, please!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Just like Lady Ardan... Carefully, so 
carefully..."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Wah! Thanks to you, Big Sis, I'm getting 
prettier and――

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Achoo!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Bright-oneechan!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh my~ You mustn't move~.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
That's not it... Jeez. You were drenched 
in sweat, so you must've caught a chill.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It'd be awful if you caught a cold. Let's 
go get you changed first, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Phew. This time for sure, I shall be the 
one to look after you~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Lady Curren, is there anything you would 
like to do?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Then, how about an afternoon nap? Curren 
trained super hard, so I wanna take a nap 
with Big Sis Bright♪"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Then to help you sleep well, I shall sing 
you a lullaby~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Sleeeep, sleeeep...♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Ngh... gotta... sleep... *snooze*...

Even after that, Mejiro Bright tried to 
act like a "big sister," but her efforts 
somehow completely missed the mark...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it flew by in the blink of an eye~. I 
was hoping to take care of you a bit 
longer...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I was actually planning to 
take proper care of you, just like dearest 
Ryan would have, you know~?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Geez, even though Curren managed to call 
you "Big Sister Bright"~.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren had so much fun♪ You showed me so 
many cute sides of yourself, and I finally 
got a big sister I can pamper myself with.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Lady Curren...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, can I call Bright-san... "Big Sis 
Bright" again?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Fufufu... By all means!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Still, next time I shall pamper you even 
moooore! After all, I am your big sister!

Mejiro Bright is brimming with motivation. 
Though it's a little concerning that she 
needed help all the way to the end...
choice_data_list:
Getting looked after like that might just 
be a skill of yours...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes♪ I'll become an even better "big 
sister" who takes great care of everyone~

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I can't wait. I hope you pamper 
Curren lots and loooots♪

Even after that, you could often spot the 
duo around the academy grounds, leaving 
everyone wondering who was actually taking 
care of whom.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Curren learned so, so much 
from big sis Bright♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, umm...? I'm not entirely sure what 
for, but I'm truly honored by your 
praise~!

She didn't seem to know the reason, but 
seeing Mejiro Bright look so happy warmed 
my heart.
